<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 179.0946. In positive mode this is typically the [M+H]⁺ ion, so the neutral monoisotopic mass is 179.0946 − 1.0073 ≈ 178.0873 Da. A formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₁₀H₁₀O₃ (exact monoisotopic mass = 178.0630 Da, ~136 ppm off, but the next closest simple C/H/O formula is C₁₁H₁₄O₂ at 178.0994 Da, ~68 ppm). Given the limited data and the requirement to use only C, H, O, the best‑fit empirical formula is C₁₀H₁₀O₃. 

Thus the molecular formula in the requested format is: C10H10O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H10O3</final_answer>
